versions.content: If a wakeup event (e.g. toggling a wakeup line, communication on a CAN bus etc.) occurs while the ECU is in Halt or Poll, then the ECU Manager module shall regain control and exit the SLEEP phase by executing the WakeupRestart sequence. An ISR may be invoked to handle the wakeup event, but this depends on the hardware and the driver implementation.
